fields.English Titel: ❤️ UFE ISCHS ZIEL 🚀 A look behind the scenes during the UHC Pfannenstiel's promotion season
fields.Page Content: This one-hour documentary follows the first team of the Pfannenstiel floorball club on their journey to promotion to the second-highest Swiss league, the National League B. The film tells the gripping story of how UHC Pfannestiel overcame two bitter defeats in the 1st league final to finally achieve their goal at the third attempt. It provides intimate insights into the inner workings of the team, the highs and lows during the playoffs. Whether it's the coach's speeches in the locker room, car rides to the game, or cleaning up after home games, the camera is always there. Many people know UHC Pfannenstiel from the entertaining videos on their Instagram channel. The film impressively shows that floorball is more than just “fun” for this team. Behind the self-irony and a certain looseness lies a lot of hard work and seriousness (not on the part of the players 😉).
fields.Name: ❤️ UFE ISCHS ZIEL 🚀 Ein Blick hinter die Kulissen während der Aufstiegssaison des UHC Pfannenstiel

fields.Page Content: Chronicles the journey of the Czech men’s national team from changes in coaching staff up to preparations for the 2024 World Floorball Championships in Malmö. Highlights include Czechia’s silver-medal run at WFC 2022, the delayed 2020 WFC (played 2021), qualifiers, and Euro Floorball Tour events, with interviews from star players
fields.Name: Next Step: Pursuing the Dream

fields.English Titel: Documentary Berlin Rockets – 30 years of floorball in Berlin
fields.Page Content:
This 6-episode YouTube series, produced by Frame Kollektiv, tells the story of the Berlin Rockets — from their early beginnings to the most recent season.

For over 30 years, the Berlin Rockets (formerly BAT Berlin, and before that a sports group within the District Office Tempelhof-Schöneberg e.V.) have been the most successful Floorball club in Berlin and one of the largest in Germany.
fields.Name: Dokumentation Berlin Rockets - 30 Jahre Floorball in Berlin

fields.English Titel: Top 4 in sight – the road to the top #WFC 2022 Men Switzerland
fields.Page Content: Follows the German men’s national team during their final training camp and throughout the 2022 World Floorball Championships in Switzerland. Offers never-before-seen behind-the-scenes footage (team meetings, locker room prep, free-time) as Germany – ranked 6th in the world – strives to close the gap to the “Top 4” nations
fields.Name: Top 4 im Visier - der Weg NaCH oben #WFC 2022 Herren Schweiz

fields.English Titel: The Power of Goalkeepers | BLINDSAVE Story
fields.Page Content: A documentary film made by floorball goalie brand BLINDSAVE about its brand, product evolution, and goalkeeping. Featuring world-class goalies like Patrik Aman, Pascal Meier, Lara Heini, Viktor Kastegren, Mike Trolle and founder Andis Blinds.
fields.Name: The Power of Goalkeepers | BLINDSAVE Story

fields.English Titel: Us – world champions? The national floorball team ahead of the World Championships on home turf
fields.Page Content: Follows the Swiss men’s national team for a year leading up to the 2022 home World Championship, asking whether Switzerland can finally triumph at a home WFC.
fields.Name: Wir - Weltmeister? Die Unihockey Nati vor der Heim-WM

fields.Page Content: A sport documentary series following the world’s top floorball twins, Oona and Veera Kauppi , through the 2021–22 season. It covers their life as 24-year-old pros in the Swedish Superliga (playing for a club in Umeå aiming to win the championship) and the lead-up to the 2021 Women’s WFC where the sisters face each other on Sweden vs. Finland national teams.
fields.Name: Vinna hela skiten

fields.Page Content:
This is the inspiring story of Florbal Mladá Boleslav – an elite Czech floorball side. It is the only Czech team (and perhaps in the world, too) who made it from the lowest league to the very top after winning the Superfinal in 2018. A club history documentary chronicling the Rrise of Technology Florbal Mladá Boleslav, one of Czech Republic’s top teams. Starting from the club’s founding in 1998, it shows how “Bolka” climbed from 5th division to Czech champions in 20 years (winning their first title in 2018). The film includes interviews with key figures reflecting on the journey, and footage from humble local gyms to the sport’s biggest stages

.
fields.Name: MADE IN BOLKA: THE FILM

fields.Page Content: A film crew led by filmmaker Yann Ruh accompanied the NLA team during the 2016/17 season, resulting in an hour-long film that offers an exciting glimpse behind the scenes of the Floorball club and shows the NLA team from a different perspective. An absolute highlight for every FBK fan and Floorball enthusiast.
fields.Name: ERWARTUNGEN - Floorball Köniz der Film

fields.Page Content: A documentary series about Johan Samuelsson, one of Sweden’s top floorball players and long-time captain of the national team. Produced by UNIHOC, it offers a personal look into Samuelsson’s career and personality, including behind-the-scenes insights into his training, matchday mindset, and life on and off the court.
fields.Name: UNIHOC Documentaries: Johan Samuelsson

fields.Page Content: A documentary series by the same creators as “Inside Pixbo,” this documentary goes behind the scenes with Storvreta IBK of Uppsala – a multiple Swedish champion team – during the climax of an SSL season. It offers up-close insight into Storvreta’s training, locker-room atmosphere, and quest for the championship.
fields.Name: Dokumentär inside Storvreta IBK

fields.Page Content: This is the first part of a UNIHOC-produced documentary series highlighting Kim Nilsson, the renowned striker for AIK Innebandy and a stalwart of the Swedish National Team. It presents an intimate, behind-the-scenes look at a day in Nilsson’s life—featuring moments at his workplace, during a professional photo shoot, and presumably on the court. The film offers insights into his daily routine, his dedication to the sport, and his life as both an elite athlete and a public figure.
fields.Name: UNIHOC Documentaries: Kim Nilsson

fields.Page Content: A documentary series following Pixbo Wallenstam, a top Swedish Superliga (SSL) club, over the course of a week during their season. Provides a look into training, matches, and team dynamics of one of Sweden’s floorball powerhouses. This was one of the first in-depth club documentaries, produced by Klubbhuset.
fields.Name: Dokumentär Inside Pixbo/Wallenstam

fields.Page Content: A documentary series about Martin Östholm, one of the world’s leading defenders in floorball. Produced by UNIHOC, it provides a personal snapshot of Östholm’s life and career, featuring behind-the-scenes footage of his training routines, matchday preparations, and his professional persona both on and off the field.
fields.Name: UNIHOC Documentaries: Martin Östholm
